programs.name: ANEW Trades Rotation Pre-Apprenticeship
programs.summary: A 280-hour pre-apprenticeship recognized by the Washington State Apprenticeship Training Council that helps women gain the skills to enter apprenticeships in construction or transportation. It's part-time so participants can keep working, and includes OSHA 10, forklift, and road flagging certifications. Its target audiences include people in low-wage industries, formerly incarcerated people, women, people of color, and veterans.

source.name: Career Bridge: ANEW Trades Rotation Pre-Apprenticeship
source.authority: Washington Workforce Training and Education Coordinating Board

quotes: ANEW's construction pre-apprenticeship program is 280 hours of training that has been recognized by the Washington State Apprenticeship Training Council.
The Trades Rotation Program (TRP) is a pre-apprenticeship that assists women in gaining the skills to successfully enter an apprenticeship in construction or transportation fields.
Our target audiences include people working in low-wage industries, formerly incarcerated, women, people of color, and veterans.
It is designed as a part-time program so participants can find or keep employment while in class
Students also gain OSHA 10, forklift operation and road flagging certifications.
